title: Ecology SpeciesAreaIsland

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the species-area relationship analysis for island biogeography. Key findings: (1) Power law model S = 14.31 × A^0.220 with significant positive relationship (p = 0.017, R² = 0.223); (2) z-value of 0.220 consistent with theoretical expectations for islands; (3) Model comparison showed power law outperformed linear and logarithmic alternatives; (4) Two outlier islands identified with unusually high species richness; (5) Conservation implications include predictions for species richness at different area scales and guidance for reserve design. All deliverables completed: analysis code, intermediate outputs, figures, and comprehensive report.
